Assessment: The statement balances a solid labor market and economic activity with inflation running below target. New Keynesian guidance (Woodford) and inflation-forecast targeting (Svensson) suggest maintaining an accommodative stance when inflation is below the 2 percent objective and expectations are anchored; the Committee’s emphasis on low market-based inflation compensation and “symmetric” inflation goals reflects that literature. At the same time, signaling “gradual increases” in the federal funds rate and proceeding with balance sheet normalization aligns with Taylor-style prescriptions when slack diminishes, and with inflation-bias concerns about maintaining credibility. Hurricane-related price effects are treated as temporary supply shocks, which standard advice is to look through rather than tighten against. Net tone: slightly positive/hawkish but close to neutral.
